title: How to Do a Proper Push-Up at Home
intro: The push-up is a no-equipment upper body exercise that trains your chest, shoulders and arms all at once. If you can't do a full one yet, start with the knee or wall version first. That's already very good.
muscles: Chest (pectorals), front shoulders, back of the arms (triceps) and core. Honest note: push-ups strengthen your arms, but they don't specifically remove arm fat. Fat goes down from your whole body through eating and daily movement.
steps: Place your hands on the floor, slightly wider than your shoulders, fingers pointing forward.
Straighten your legs behind you until your body is straight from head to heels.
Tighten your tummy and glutes so your hips don't drop.
Bend your elbows backwards (about 45 degrees from your body) and lower your chest.
Go down until your chest almost touches the floor.
Push the floor to come back up while breathing out.
mistakes: Hips dropping or bum sticking up. Imagine your body as a straight plank.
Elbows flaring out too wide. This puts stress on your shoulders. Bring them a bit closer to your body.
Head going down first or doing half reps. Your chest goes down, neck stays neutral.
easier: Do push-ups with your hands on a sturdy table or sofa (incline push-up), or knee push-ups.
harder: Lower slowly for 3 seconds, hold 1-2 seconds at the bottom, or put your feet on a chair (decline push-up).
dose: 2-3 sets x as many reps as you can do with good technique (usually 3-10), keeping 1-2 reps in the tank. Do it 2-3 times a week.
safety: Stop if you feel sharp pain in your shoulders, elbows or wrists. If the pain keeps coming back, see a doctor or physiotherapist.

faq.q: I can't do even one push-up. What should I do?
faq.a: Very normal for beginners. Start with wall push-ups, then table push-ups, then knee push-ups. Move up a level when you can do 3 sets x 12 comfortably.

faq.q: Can push-ups get rid of flabby arms?
faq.a: Push-ups strengthen your arm muscles, but you can't choose where fat comes off. Arm fat goes down when your overall eating and daily activity are consistent. Stronger muscles still help your arms feel firmer.

faq.q: Why do my wrists hurt during push-ups?
faq.a: Try placing your hands directly under your shoulders and press with your whole palm, not just the heel of your hand. You can also make a fist or do them on a table. If it still hurts, stop and get advice from a physio.
